title: Run survey estimation for a given entity and set of reporting dimensions — fct_arenalyse
text: Computes weighted means totals per hectare measures selected entity, stratified clustered according sampling design described chain summary. Supports simple random sampling (SRS), stratified SRS, cluster sampling designs.

title: Run survey estimation for a given entity and set of reporting dimensions — fct_arenalyse
Run survey estimation for a given entity and set of reporting dimensions — fct_arenalyse
text: .zip Named list produced fct_readzip(). Must contain: chain_summary Survey chain metadata (sampling strategy, base unit, result variables, language, etc.). schema_summary Data dictionary describing input dimensions. report_dimensions Available reporting dimensions. MAU_ Minimal Area Unit tables target entity. .entity Character scalar. Name entity analyse (e.g. "tree", "plot"). .dim Character vector. Names reporting dimensions include (e.g. c("plot_forest_type", "plot_province")). .pvalue P-value standard error estimation. .cm Compute mode, One "fast" "safe". "fast" computes measures single survey summary call; "safe" computes measure separately keeps partial results measures fail. .lonely Lonely-PSU handling strategy. One : "adjust" (default) Substitutes grand mean across strata single-PSU stratum's variance contribution, extended domain (grouped) estimates via survey.adjust.domain.lonely = TRUE. Produces conservative (upward-biased) valid SE. Recommended fine-grained cross-tabulations expected. "remove" Drops lone stratum variance computation (survey.adjust.domain.lonely = FALSE). Faster less conservative, can silently underestimate SE affected groups. May still error domain estimates lonely PSU falls within reporting group — safe base-unit dimensions strata well-populated. .pb_ss Shiny session shinyWidgets::updateProgressBar(). Default NULL. .pb_id widget ID shinyWidgets::updateProgressBar(). Default NULL.

title: Run survey estimation for a given entity and set of reporting dimensions — fct_arenalyse
text: named list two elements: MEANS Tibble per-hectare survey means standard errors confidence intervals measure × dimension combination. TOTALS Tibble estimated totals derived MEANS multiplying expansion area. tibbles include area, item_count, base_unit_count, optionally cluster_count columns.
